description: This file defines a serializer (codec) for the IPEndPoint class, including methods for reading and writing its data, and a shallow copier for EndPoint objects. It is part of the Orleans.Serialization framework, specifically for serializing network endpoint data.

classes.name: IPEndPointCodec
classes.description: Serializer for IPEndPoint, handling serialization and deserialization of network endpoint data.

classes.name: EndPointCopier
classes.description: A shallow copier for EndPoint objects, used for object copying within the serialization framework.

methods.name: ReadValue
methods.description: Reads an IPEndPoint object from the serialization stream, reconstructing it from its serialized form.

methods.name: WriteField
methods.description: Serializes an IPEndPoint object into the serialization stream.

methods.name: WriteField (static)
methods.description: Serializes an IPEndPoint object without type info, assuming the expected type is known.
